title: Vertical Drama Episode Quality Review Output

contract_version.description: 1 = shipped v1 scorecard (reversal_count/sharpness, emotion_variety, dialogue_naturalness, pacing, overall). 2 = superset (added 2026-07-07) adding scorecard.hook_strength/cliffhanger_strength/continuity_consistency/tie_in_naturalness plus the top-level density_metrics block. v1 artifacts remain readable under this schema; default is 1 when not requested.

hook_strength.description: Optional superset (contract_version 2, added 2026-07-07): how strongly the episode's hook/first seconds grab attention.

cliffhanger_strength.description: Optional superset (contract_version 2): how sharply the cliffhanger pays off the final reversal.

continuity_consistency.description: Optional superset (contract_version 2): whether character state, wardrobe/prop continuity, and established facts stay consistent across script and storyboard.

tie_in_naturalness.description: Optional superset (contract_version 2): 1-5, or null when no product tie-in is configured for this episode. See 'tie_in_assessment'.

tie_in_assessment.description: Optional superset (contract_version 2, added 2026-07-07): one-or-two-sentence qualitative note supporting scorecard.tie_in_naturalness, citing the specific shot/line that helped or hurt naturalness. Omitted (not null) when no tie-in is configured.

density_metrics.description: Optional superset (contract_version 2, added 2026-07-07, story-density reform): deterministic density facts computed in code from the platform's canonical speech-budget module and script/storyboard markers, injected into this skill's input and echoed VERBATIM here — the LLM must never re-estimate these numbers. Present only when the caller supplied deterministic density input.

per_clip_coverage.description: Deterministic summary of per-clip speech-coverage ratio vs. target/floor bands.

reversal_count.description: Deterministic count of script beats/markers where is_reversal === true, computed in code — distinct from scorecard.reversal_count, which is this skill's own judgment (and may corroborate or, if markers are missing upstream, infer this count).
